title: Book Three · Chapter 52: The Return Bus
story:
On Wednesday, Ronan reaches the bus station before half past nine.

Leo and his aunt are outside the front doors. The small case is beside her feet. Leo's bag looks full again.

“Less paper?” Ronan asks.

“More food. My grandmother won.”

His aunt smiles and checks the tickets. The bus leaves at ten. They have enough time to find the right place inside.

Ronan walks with them to the waiting area. The aunt puts her case beside a chair and goes to check the gate number with a worker.

The boys stand near the window.

Outside, another bus turns slowly. A man guides it past a cart with one lifted hand.

“I know this part now,” Leo says.

“The station?”

“Leaving.”

Ronan looks at the bag on his shoulder.

“Four nights went fast.”

“The bun went faster.”

“You had the bigger half.”

Leo laughs. Then his face grows quiet again.

“Tell Kai I liked the games.”

“Tell him yourself next time.”

“I will. And Anna's window. I will look for the book.”

Ronan nods. Around them, people lift bags and call to children. The aunt comes back with the gate number.

“We can go over now.”

She keeps both tickets in her hand as they move toward the next line of people.

Leo gives Ronan a quick hug. This time, he holds the bag out of the way.

“Write when you get back,” Ronan says.

“By the end of the week.”

“All right.”

Leo goes with his aunt. At the gate, he turns and lifts a hand.

Ronan lifts his own. He stays until the two of them pass through and join the line beside the bus.

Then he steps back. He does not need to stand in the way of the next family.

A few minutes later, he sees the bus through the wide window. Leo is beside his aunt near the middle. His bag is at his feet.

The driver closes the door. Leo puts one hand against the window as the bus begins to move.

Ronan keeps his hand up until it turns out of sight.

Outside the station, the morning feels hotter. He drinks from his bottle before he starts home.

At West Lane, Mr Qiu asks about the bus.

“Gone,” Ronan says. “On time.”

“Good visit?”

“Yes.”

He goes through the green door. Mum is pinning a sleeve near the window. Dad is at work.

Ronan tells her the bus left. Then he brings his bottle to the kitchen and washes it.

There are still things he meant to show Leo. He thinks of one, then another. He puts a clean sheet beside his new pen and writes down two street names for the next letter.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

waiting area＝候车区；gate number＝检票口编号；guide＝引导；out of sight＝看不见了。

## 理解问题

1. Leo和姨妈乘几点的车回去？他们是否有足够时间确认检票口？
2. Leo答应什么时候写信？这次分别和上次相比，有哪些不同？

## 读句子

**His bag is at his feet.**

拆开看：His bag / is / at his feet.

他的包／放着／放在脚边。
